title: NS-DWR3SS1 — Service test mode entry
description: Enter service/factory test mode to verify dispenser and outputs (page 27 control layout).

source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-DWR3SS1 Top Control Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Door closed, power ready
steps.body: Close the door. Press Power to wake the control (hold 3 seconds to turn on from standby).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn on / off the power by press and hold power for 3 seconds.

steps.title: Service test entry
steps.body: Per factory-mode control layout (page 27): with power on, press Start/Cancel to enter service test. Use service test to verify detergent/rinse module operation (page 13). Press Start/Cancel to step tests.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Operation of the detergent/rinse module can be checked by using the service test mode.
